guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description explicitly says the customer selects the route, date, and time, while the records show that the date-and-time selection task and its following flow are absent. This refines FID-01 by clarifying how to represent a described selection.)

same as LRN-013 (The description says the system sends the ticket to the customer and the customer provides payment details (S2, S3), while the generated labels change the sending action to receiving and alter the stated payment action (P5, P7). This supports a general label-faithfulness guideline already expressed by LRN-013.)

refines FID-01 (The description names personal information and payment details, while the records show that the payment-details activity has no counterpart in the generated model. This refines FID-01 by clarifying that distinct information-provision activities should remain explicit.)

same as LRN-013 (The description specifies multiple activity details and alternatives that are omitted, narrowed, or changed in the label pairs. The proposed guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-013.)

refines GW-04 (The description names sending the generated ticket and updating inventory as follow-up activities, and the missing-flow records show the reference uses parallel-gateway connections around these activities. This adds a specific application of the documented parallel-split guidance.)

same as LRN-013 (The description says the ticket is sent to the customer, while one generated label reverses that direction; other pairs show labels omitting or altering stated activity information. This is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-013.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a participant selects or specifies inputs before a subsequent process action: Model that selection or specification as an explicit task before the dependent action.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant selects or specifies inputs before a subsequent process action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions: Preserve those stated details in the BPMN task label rather than omitting or substituting them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an action, object, recipient, or direction of information transfer

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a participant supplies multiple distinct categories of information, even when they are mentioned in one combined step: Model each stated information-provision activity explicitly rather than combining distinct categories into a single activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant supplies multiple distinct categories of information, even when they are mentioned in one combined step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives: Model the activities as concurrent branches using a parallel gateway, and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before any subsequent activity that depends on all branches being complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives
